verdicts.why: Mike is gone until S2E16, and Jemma's first on-screen scene with him in S2 is the S2E19 rescue, where she treats him and then talks with Fitz about rebuilding his parts. The old testing and mission-prep claim is not shown; S2E17 only mentions that her lab work was on his upgrades.
In T.R.A.C.K.S. (S1E13) Mike gets the Project Deathlok leg, serves the Clairvoyant, ignores Skye and leaves her to be shot while Coulson's team raids Quinn's villa.
Gonzales' past under Fury and the Iliad flashback where he first backs Fury's order are in One Door Closes (S2E15).
Gonzales takes the Playground and demands the Toolbox in S2E15, and Coulson refuses and escapes. The merger and his killing by Jiaying come in Scars (S2E20), so the split is right.
Coulson and Price spend the night together at the end of Chaos Theory (S3E7), and Ward shoots her in Closure (S3E9).
In All the Comforts of Home (S5E11), the masked Ruby leads the robot soldiers against Coulson's team at the Kree beacon and orders them killed. Coulson later names her as that attacker in S5E15.
Ghost Rider only comes back at the end of S4E21. He tears through the Superior's LMD bodies and chains him for Quake in World's End (S4E22).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#13
value.text: Ruby Hale and Werner von Strucker were childhood friends. Sent by her mother to win him over, Ruby persuades Werner to stay and hints that he could be with her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Ruby's childhood friend, whom she persuades to stay.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Werner's childhood friend, who persuades him to stay.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
split.text: Ruby kisses Werner before her infusion, then accidentally kills him when she cannot control the gravitonium.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Ruby's childhood friend and lover. She accidentally kills him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Werner's childhood friend and lover. Accidentally kills him.

verdicts.why: The split and dates are right: Principia (S5E13) has the childhood-friend recognition and Ruby talking him into staying, and the kiss and his death are in S5E18. But the S5E13 stage cannot keep kind partner when its own text says they are only childhood friends she is sent to win over, so it gets kind friend and partner moves to the split.
Quake first turns up and blasts Ramon in Deal Breaker (Slingshot episode 5), and he dies in episode 6.
In Emancipation (S3E20) Coulson brings Talbot to the Playground, where he is with Mack after the staged Lincoln escape and when Daisy returns.
Talbot's act with Mack, the Lighthouse signal, grabbing Robin and Mack's I.C.E.R. shot are all in S5E18. The Graviton attack on Mack outside his home is in S5E21.

Daisy, under Hive's sway, breaks Mack's arm and beats him in Union City in Failed Experiments (S3E19). The Theta-wave trap at the missile silo, with Lincoln working the machine, is in Absolution (S3E21).
Mack breaches Ivanov's Russian naval base with an RPG and he and Coulson find Mace in The Man Behind the Shield (S4E14). The rig explosion with Mack still in the Framework is S4E21.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#19
value.text: During the siege of the Lighthouse, Elena leads a handcuffed Talbot to safety, and he greets her as Speedy. He then ices Simmons, absorbs the gravitonium and uses it to tear apart the Remorath attacking Elena.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The general who calls Elena Speedy, then takes the gravitonium for himself.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The agent Talbot calls Speedy, who leads him through the siege.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#21
split.text: When Elena and Mack come to stop Graviton at his family's home, he crashes their cars and blocks their bullets, then flies off after his son says he is no hero.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The general turned Graviton, who attacks Elena and Mack at his home.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Talbot attacks at his home as Graviton.

verdicts.why: The S5E19 events (Speedy, handcuffs, icing Simmons, the gravitonium) and the S5E21 home attack are right. But at the end of S5E19 Talbot is on their side, killing the Remorath that are overrunning Elena, Davis and Piper. So that stage needs kind ally, and enemy starts with the S5E21 split.
Face My Enemy (S2E4) lists Natasha Romanoff among Melinda May's phone contacts.
Face My Enemy (S2E4) lists Jimmy Woo among Melinda May's phone contacts, and Woo's page cites that episode.
Ward vouching for Coulson and Simmons to the Patriot, and telling him Skye may be in danger, are in Identity and Change (S4E17). S4E18 is where Mace dies.
The team saves Sousa and he joins them in Out of the Past (S7E4). Retaking the Lighthouse with Yo-Yo and their talk about Mack and Daisy is S7E13.
Ramon shoots Francisco in Bouncing Back (S3E11), and Elena helps storm his police station. In Slingshot episode 2 she tells Mace that Ramon has escaped and takes his lanyard to hunt him down.

In Alien Commies from the Future! (S7E3) Sousa has Coulson arrested, Coulson says he is a fan, and Sousa then joins his fight against the Chronicom and accepts they may be the good guys. The rescue from his death is S7E4.
In the restaurant Anitolov only pulls out Hope's seat. He shoots at her after she attacks in the Wasp suit.
List recruiting the twins at street protests comes only from the prelude comic. On screen the twins volunteered and List runs the Scepter experiments, then urges Strucker to send them out.
List recruiting the twins at street protests comes only from the prelude comic. On screen they volunteered, the other subjects died, and List urges sending out the twins.

Ultron's visit to Strucker's cell is a deleted scene, so the film never shows Strucker telling him about Klaue. The Avengers see Strucker dead with 'PEACE' on the wall and find their files on him erased.
Strucker pointing Ultron to Klaue happens only in the deleted cell scene. In the film the Avengers get to Klaue through Strucker's paper files.
The name 'Black Order' is never said on screen in Infinity War; Wikipedia's article carries an editor note saying so.
The name 'Black Order' is never said on screen in Infinity War; Wikipedia's article carries an editor note saying so.
Episode 1 already shows Wanda and Vision as newlyweds in Westview. The flashback of her grief creating the Hex and a new Vision is episode 8, so that part becomes the split.

The Captain Marvel mid-credits scene has Carol answering the pager and turning up at the Compound, where Steve and the others are, asking where Fury is. The strike on Thanos and the Battle of Earth are in Endgame. The title exists in the app.
Carol arrives at the Compound looking for Fury in the Captain Marvel mid-credits scene, with Rhodes there. Rhodey asking her about Thanos and the hologram check-ins are in Endgame.
Laura is pregnant in Age of Ultron, and Nathaniel Pietro is born and shown at the end of the film. The picnic catch is the Endgame opening.

value.text: Bruce Banner faces Cull Obsidian in Greenwich Village but cannot turn into the Hulk. In Wakanda he fights him in the Hulkbuster armor and kills him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: One of Thanos's warriors. Bruce can't turn into the Hulk to fight him in New York, then kills him in Wakanda.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Avenger who can't turn into the Hulk in New York, then kills Cull in Wakanda.

verdicts.why: Correct: Bruce fails to turn into the Hulk in Greenwich Village, Tony does the fighting, and Bruce kills Cull from the Hulkbuster in Wakanda. The card's 'Black Order' label is never used on screen, so the card is changed too.

value.text: In Edinburgh, Natasha ambushes Corvus Glaive as he attacks Wanda and Vision and stabs him with Proxima Midnight's spear.
value.on_b_card_about_a: One of Thanos's warriors, whom Natasha stabs with Proxima's spear in Edinburgh.

verdicts.why: Correct: in Wakanda Natasha fights Proxima, and Corvus fights Steve and is killed by Vision, so the two never face each other there. The card on Natasha's side says 'Black Order', a name the film never uses, so it is changed too.

value.text: Ebony Maw boards the Statesman with Thanos and helps slaughter the fleeing Asgardians. When Thor attacks Thanos, Maw pins him in twisted metal, then gags him when he cries out as Thanos kills Heimdall.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A follower of Thanos who slaughters Asgardians and gags Thor on the Statesman.

verdicts.why: Correct: Maw pins Thor after Thor tries to strike Thanos, and gags him when he cries out as Heimdall dies, all before Loki is killed. Thor's card calls Maw a 'Black Order member', a name never used on screen, so it is changed too.
After the Snap Okoye serves with the Avengers under Natasha and checks in by hologram with her, Rhodes, Carol, Rocket and Nebula. Steve is not on that call. She fights in the Battle of Earth.
When they sync up to jump back, Nebula's link with her 2014 self makes her glitch, and Rhodes goes home with the Orb not knowing she stayed. Only after that is she taken aboard the 2014 Sanctuary II.
On screen Valkyrie is simply alive in New Asgard in Endgame. That she led the refugees out comes from the directors' comments.
On the Benatar it is Drax who tells Thor that Gamora is Thanos' adopted daughter. Gamora then explains Thanos' plan to wipe out half of all life.
Okoye alone stops the FBI van, wearing the Midnight Angel armor, and frees Ross ('A colonizer in chains'). Aneka is not in that scene.
Ramonda, Shuri, Nakia and Ross flee to the Jabari, whose land is inside Wakanda.
